profile.headline: Software Engineer for Embedded RTOS, Linux device driver, Android, VxWorks, wireless mobile LTE, Defense Security clearance, Tensorflow
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in Embedded S/W development. Skilled in Android, Linux Device Driver, LTE, Mobile Communications,  Artificial Intelligence, Mobile TV, RTOS, baseband modem S/W, RF transceiver control. Strong engineering professional with a Master's degree focused in Electronics and Communications Engineering.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Embedded Software Development and Design for Defense Projects with active security clearance
Develop the Texas Instrument Arago Linux kernel S/W for board configuration and drivers.
Build U-Boot image with device tree and pin mux configuration based on H/W schematic.
Bring up the embedded board with Xilinx Ultrascale  and implement secure boot with blowing eFUSE for RSA authentication and AES encryption.
Implement the SNMP interface functions to handle object identifiers of Management Information Base through Simple Network Management Protocol between Master Agent and Manager.
Develop the Linux multi-thread applications for LED control and button handler via GPIO Control.
Design the system network architecture with Linux RNDIS, Bridge, Multi-Cast, configuration of Ethernet Switch, and validate the video streaming on it.
Implement SNMP GUI application on NetBean Java IDE
Bring up H/W board TI Sitara MPU with MLO, UBoot, Linux BSP and device tree configuration.
BSP Software development with STM32L552 microcontroller
Partitioning eMMC and programming Micro SD card and eMMC as booting image.
Giga ethernet configuration as rgmii and network setting.
The design of radio control software (based on C++ OOP) to control the Common Data Link waveforms.
S/W development management through Klocwork static code analysis, Bitbucket and Jira
Linux power management using CPU frequency governing.
Communication interface S/W development and debugging for configuration of Xilinx FPGA modules and RF board.
Develop Microcontroller Software to control AD9361 RF transceiver.
Integrate secure boot and key management into the platform based on u-boot and Linux.
Write shell scripts to generate RSA and AES security keys for OTP programming.
Develop RF transceiver control S/W for L/S/C RF band and cellular network.
Develop the embedded software compatible with Common Data Link specification for secure digital communication.
positions.insights: Skills: ARM Assembly · Defining Requirements · System Configuration · Software Requirements · Scripting · Software Architecture · Software Infrastructure · MATLAB

positions.description:

Develop Linux kernel driver and applications
Implement VxWorks applications for MIL-STD-1553, network socket communication and file storage
Video application using Gstreamer on Petalinux.
Xilinx Linux V4L2 pipeline driver, FSBL, UBoot
Implement Built In Test functions for Defense projects
Technical writing on S/W design documents
Configure the Ethernet Switch through SNMP (Simple Network Management Protocol)
Integrate the Boundary Layer Protection solution for ethernet and 1553.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
The architectural technical leader for native mobile apps over 1 million cellular users &
Android App full stack development
5+ years experience building Android application using Android SDK
Strong background in mobile software development in Android.
Programming with Java, Kotlin, C/C++, Python
Best practices for Client/Server communication and performance optimizations.
Experience in JNI/NDK, XML, JSON, Restful API, SQLite Database
AI Development of segmentation model using TensorFlow Deeplab model.
Strong background knowledge in wireless system (LTE/GSM/1xCDMA/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth)
Understanding of full mobile development life cycle, source control, MVVM design
Broad experience in coding and debugging for many areas such as Android application, framework, network protocol stack.
- Server/Client Network communication such as IMAP, HTTP, SMS and architectural design on Visual Voice Mail for VZW, AT&T 
  and Tracfone carriers.
- Wireless Emergency Alert Message Application including WEA 3.0 GPS Network provider
Native mobile S/W development
- Developed PPP and data socket communication for tethered mode and apps
- Implemented functions for CDG2 certification over Racal and CallBox
- Implemented EVRC voice-buffering for Push to Talk.
Embedded S/W programming
- Android Remote diagnostic feature implementation such as bridge between IQ Agent master and slave and network porting layer
TensorFlow Deeplab model for AI segmentation model development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mobile TV chip S/W driver development
- Developed device driver of Mobile TV System On Chip for DVB-T/H and ISDB-T
- Implemented the interface driver such as EBI, I2C, TSIF and SPI.
- Validated SOC under RTOS as like REX, Nucleus and WINCE at embedded system board
- Had the experience of A/V decoder such as MPEG2 and H.264  
Embedded SW design

positions.title: Senior Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Launched PC5740 EVDO/1X PCMCIA card -Verizon Sprint
- Developed CDMA Protocol Stack for CDG2 Certification
- Developed Data protocol for EVDO/1X
- Implemented the API functions of Verizon Access Manager and Sprint Connection Manager
- Field Interoperability Testing and data throughput performance testing for CDG3
Implemented OEM layer of JSR-179 for J2ME based location based services

positions.title: Senior Staff System Engineer
positions.description:
Developed the call processing compatible with CDG2 certification from Lucent, Motorola and Nortel.
Implemented the Firmware Downloading Application.
Designed the system determination algorithm for efficient Verizon network acquisition.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
As functional leader of handset software development team, developed Short Message Services and patented algorithm to edit the Korean Language.
Performed as a member of TFT to debug and resolve the major field issues of Hyundai cellular phone.
Collaborated with  DSPC (Tel Aviv, Israel) and LSI Logic (San Diego, CA) for the cellular phone with baseband chipset.
